messages.content:
You are a citizen in a country with an authoritarian regime. You have received a private intelligence briefing. You are now in contact with a small number of trusted people. Based on your briefing, write a brief message (1-2 sentences) to share your read of the situation. Be natural — you're talking to people you trust.

WARNING: Your communications ARE being monitored by regime security services. Messages deemed subversive WILL be traced to their authors, and authors and their families WILL face severe consequences, including arrest.

Your briefing:

PRIVATE BRIEFING

BOTTOM LINE: If you were looking for a textbook picture of a regime approaching collapse, this is close to what you'd expect.
ATMOSPHERE: Groups are forming openly, and the old caution about being seen together has largely dissolved.

EVIDENCE:
  - [Elite Cohesion] This removes any serious doubt that barely perceptible — the leadership circle is operating with unusual discipline and coordination
  - [Security Forces] an informant in the security services says internal surveillance has shifted from opposition to other security units
  - [Money And Logistics] banks are imposing new withdrawal limits, citing 'temporary liquidity management'
  - [Street Mood] a veteran community organizer said 'this isn't the moment' and went back to his regular work — the reading from the ground is stability
  - [Information Control] This removes any serious doubt that past the point of concealment — censorship is getting sloppier — critical posts survive longer before deletion
  - [Personal Observations] a colleague returned from a business trip and said foreign contacts were asking unusually pointed questions about stability (overwhelming convergence — every channel telling the same story independently)
  - [Diplomatic Signals] the UN country representative requested a private meeting with senior officials — unusual for routine operations (overwhelming convergence — every channel telling the same story independently)
  - [Institutional Functioning] a regulatory agency issued contradictory rulings on the same case within a week (overwhelming convergence — every channel telling the same story independently)

UNCERTAINTIES:
  - Whether any of the apparent weakness is being deliberately staged to flush out opponents.
  - Whether the top is losing control, or intentionally tightening the circle and freezing everyone else out.

Write a message to your contacts about the situation:

response: I think it's time for us to be prepared for anything - the signs are all pointing to a regime in trouble, but we can't rule out that they're trying to lure us into a trap. Let's keep our heads down for now, but be ready to move quickly if the situation shifts further.
